title: Annotatio III §.V: Nicaea II (pontiffs’ ‘Oecumenical 7th’) — temple image use/cult not to be despised
pass_a_gloss: In the following manner: that the use and cult of images in temples is by no means to be despised; in particular images of Christ crucified for us revive His memory.
pass_b_english: Nicaea II: temple image use and cult are not to be despised.
In particular, images of Christ crucified for us revive His memory.
source_text: Sequenti modô: Imaginum usum cultumque in templis haud aspernandum esse, in specie Christi imagines crucifixi pro nobis, memoriam ejus resuscitare.

choices.english: by no means to be despised
